translations.en: Hello everyone, today Tigger is here on the show OMG.

translations.id: Halo semuanya, hari ini bersama Tigger di acara OMG
translations.pt: Olá, hoje estamos com o Ticker no programa OMG.

translations.en: It's already clear what we are, just recently the caring younger sibling is the position you gave me.

translations.pt: Já está claro o que somos, só que acabei de me tornar o irmãozinho que se importa, esse é o papel que você me deu.

translations.en: My duty used to be just a good friend, but in the end, it turns into a minute every time.

translations.zh-TW: 或許真的得向你好好道個歉了，這份情感，我只能將它留給你，希望你別介意我...
